text: Gentlemen. The robot came back to a portal it had already half built, finished it, lit it, and walked into the Nether.

Here was the trouble. Any interruption, and it forgot where it was building. So it picked a new spot, one block lower, and its own old obsidian got in the way. Step off. Step back. Thirty-nine minutes.
Now it looks for a frame it already cast, and finishes that one. It even says so in chat. Recycling, gentlemen.
Same save. Before: none of three runs got past the cast. After: two out of two finished the frame, lit it, and went through. The lava lake course still passes.
In the Nether, one of them met the locals. The piglins have opinions about our dress code. No gold, no service.
Version zero point nine five point six one. Out now. Gold trousers are on the list.
